From Nicaragua to India, and tips from the field
File the Bill of Entry through a licensed customs broker in India (YAM holds licence R-7/92).
Check the HS code in the Indian tariff, the DGFT import policy (free, restricted or prohibited) and any BIS, FSSAI, plant quarantine or other permit before the goods ship.
If an agreement applies, get the correct certificate of origin from the exporter to claim the lower duty.
